title: העונה השלישית בעין-גדי (En Gedi, third season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: Tel Goren and the plain between Nahal David and Nahal Arugot, about 200 m west of the shore; no map reference.
notes: Strata V (end of the Judean monarchy) and IV (Persian) on Tel Goren; Herodian lamps in a pit at a higher level (not coded: pit not described). Roman bath house in the plain (hypocaust heating channels not eligible), reused perhaps in the Bar Kokhba period; part of a larger building, perhaps the agora of En Gedi.

features.subtype: six bronze coins hidden in the cavity of a doorpost stone reused in the bath house
features.period: coins of Titus (about 80 CE) to Ascalon 117 CE; the report dates the building by them
features.quote: קבוצה של שש מטבעות ברונזה שנמצאה בתוך חלל של אבן

title: ירושלים, קברים ישראליים וסקר בסביבות ירושלים (Jerusalem: Israelite tombs and survey near Jerusalem)
author: O. Negbi and S. Nahmani; M. Feist
location_note: South-east slope of the Holyland Hotel hill; survey south of Bayit Vegan by the Manahat-Qiryat Yovel road; no map reference.
notes: The excavators link the Holyland caves with the cemetery of biblical Manahat (claim). Survey features were mapped for the Dania company.

features.subtype: natural cave partly adapted for burial, square opening, steps, central pit with bones; openings of 10 more caves located nearby
features.period: Israelite (Iron Age) pottery
features.quote: מערה טבעית שחלק ממנה הותקן למטרות קבורה

features.subtype: kokhim caves (survey south of Bayit Vegan)
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: ובורות מים רבים וכן מספר מערות כוכים

features.subtype: many water cisterns (survey)
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: ובורות מים רבים וכן מספר מערות כוכים

features.subtype: winepress and oil press (survey)
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: נתגלו מתקנים שונים הכוללים גת

title: שרידי קבר יהודי בירושלים (remains of a Jewish tomb in Jerusalem, Giv'at Shaul B)
author: L. Y. Rahmani
location_note: Giv'at Shaul B, Jerusalem; no map reference.

features.subtype: part of a kokh with a broken ossuary and lid; tomb destroyed
features.period: not dated in the report ('Jewish tomb')
features.quote: נתגלה חלק של כוך ובו גלוסקמא שבורה

title: העונה הרביעית בעין גדי (En Gedi, fourth season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: Tel Goren and the plain between Nahal David and Nahal Arugot; no map reference.
notes: Persian building (stratum IV) with plastered walls and floors; three Hasmonean-Herodian levels north of it; ovens of the time between the wars or of Bar Kokhba. Roman bath house 40 x 5 m, probably built by the Thracian unit after the destruction of the Second Temple; heating channels not eligible.

features.subtype: plastered pool entered by two steps, west of the frigidarium of the Roman bath house (excavators: bath pool)
features.period: bath house dated between the two wars (70-132 CE), perhaps destroyed in the Bar Kokhba revolt
features.quote: ממערב לו נמצאה בריכה מטויחת אליה היו יורדים בשתי

title: מוצא (Moza, Byzantine church and tomb)
author: A. Druks
location_note: By the Moza Tahtit bridge on the Tel Aviv-Jerusalem road; no map reference.

features.subtype: built burial chamber under the south aisle, steps down from the mosaic floor, three burial cells
features.period: Byzantine, same time as the church (5th-6th centuries CE)
features.quote: מרצפת הפסיפס יורדות מדרגות לתוך חדר הקבורה

features.subtype: drainage channel parallel to the west wall outside the narthex
features.period: Byzantine church (5th-6th centuries CE)
features.quote: תעלת ניקוז

title: מערת קברים בתלפיות (tomb cave in Talpiyyot, Jerusalem)
author: D. Bahat
screen_note: Talpiyyot is a Jerusalem neighbourhood (not in the gazetteer by name; exploratory by-eye match).
location_note: 'HaYozem' rest home, Talpiyyot, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Pottery and spindle bottle dated 'למאות הא'-הב׳ לפמה״נ' in the text layer (1st-2nd centuries BCE, OCR); a range that only partly overlaps the window.

features.subtype: tomb with courtyard, six kokhim and a square pit in the chamber floor
features.period: 1st-2nd centuries BCE (pottery, as printed)
features.quote: למערה בת ששה כוכים

title: מערת קברים יהודית על הר הצופים (Jewish tomb cave on Mount Scopus)
author: (Hebrew University; name garbled in the text layer)
location_note: Botanical garden of the Hebrew University, Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Eight ossuaries (one inscribed 'Yehuda bar Yehohanan'), a Herodian lamp. The author's name is garbled in the text layer.

features.subtype: typical kokhim tomb (chamber 2.5 x 2.5 m, five kokhim), entrance still closed by the original rolling stone; three more empty tombs of the same type found after the winter rains
features.period: end of the Second Temple period ('the last generations before the destruction')
features.quote: ואילו הפתח נשאר חסום ע״י אבן הגולל המקורית

title: העונה החמישית בעין גדי (En Gedi, fifth season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: North of Tel Goren, the Roman bath house and 'Givat ha-Matzeva' about 600 m north-west of Tel Goren; no map reference.
notes: Persian residence (stratum IV). Herodian building destroyed in year 2 of the First Revolt (coins). The bath-house pool is the stepped pool of HA13-001 (same feature, described here without steps).

features.subtype: channel leading from a thick-walled building to a drainage pit
features.period: probably the days of Alexander Jannaeus
features.quote: תעלה המובילה ממנו לבור ניקוז

features.subtype: large Herodian lamp buried by the courtyard wall holding 141 coins (Agrippa I, Felix, Nero)
features.period: coins of 42/3, 53/4 and 59 CE; building destroyed in 68 CE
features.quote: שהוטמן בסמוך לקיר החצר ובו מטמון של 141 מטבעות

features.subtype: plastered pool 3 x 3 m west of the frigidarium, with a paved surround 1 m wide (bath-house courtyard)
features.period: bath house between the destruction of the Second Temple and the Bar Kokhba revolt (coins)
features.quote: נוקתה הבריכה המטויחת שממערב לפריגידריום

title: מצדה (Masada, end of the excavations)
author: Y. Yadin
notes: Quoted from Yadin's press statement: Jubilees fragment, about 700 inscribed sherds, about 4000 coins in all seasons, a possible study house of the Zealots, bath-house courtyard mosaic.

features.subtype: second miqveh, in the courtyard of the large administrative building west of the storehouses (excavator: miqveh)
features.period: Second Temple period (Zealot phase; identical to the miqveh found the year before)
features.quote: יש להזכיר מקווה מהרה שני שנתגלה בחצר בניין המינהל

features.subtype: two hoards of shekels and half-shekels in neighbouring dwellings (9 + 20 with cloth remains; 6 + 6 in a bronze vessel)
features.period: First Revolt (66-70 CE)
features.quote: המטמונות נמצאו בשתי דירות שכנות

title: מערה מימי בית שני נחשפה בירושלים (Second Temple period cave exposed in Jerusalem, Tel Arza)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: End of Zephaniah Street by the Tel Arza quarter, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: One plain ossuary and a fragment of another; robbed in antiquity. Pottery and lamps dated to the 2nd and 1st centuries BCE; the title dates the cave to the Second Temple period.

features.subtype: two-room tomb: kokhim in the first room, bone-collecting room behind
features.period: 2nd and 1st centuries BCE; Second Temple period (title)
features.quote: בחדר הראשון כוכים ואילו החדר השני היה מיועד לליקוט עצמות

title: סקר ארכיאולוגי בעין בוקק (archaeological survey at En Boqeq)
author: S. Applebaum
location_note: En Boqeq and Nahal Boqeq; no map reference. INFERENCE: on the southern edge of the Z3 box.
notes: Fenced agricultural plots and two buildings (one a farm 20 x 20 m). Sherds of the large building from the 2nd century CE on; sherds of the plots probably 5th century CE on. The excavator assumes a dam north of the fort (assumption, not coded).

features.subtype: installations for directing the stream flow (old course south of the present stream)
features.period: not dated separately (plots: probably 5th century CE onwards)
features.quote: נמצאו שם שרידים של מתקנים להכוונת זרם המים

features.subtype: segment of a channel carrying spring water to the fields
features.period: not dated separately (plots: probably 5th century CE onwards)
features.quote: נתגלה קטע של תעלה שהזרימה את מי המעיין

title: ירושלים (Jerusalem: lower aqueduct on Mount Zion; tombs in the Valley of the Cross and Qiryat Menahem)
author: O. Negbi, M. Feist and S. Nahmani; S. Gudovitch
location_note: Mount Zion access road; Valley of the Cross (Emeq ha-Mazleva); Qiryat Menahem; no map references.
notes: Three sub-items under one heading. The aqueduct date is the report's statement of received knowledge ('according to our information').

features.subtype: lower aqueduct: stone-built channel covered with stone slabs, about 0.70 m high, with a square built access shaft
features.period: built in the days of the procurator Pontius Pilate (report)
features.quote: נבנתה התעלה בימיו של הנציב הרומי פונטיוס פילטרם

features.subtype: clay pipeline (0.22 m) laid in the bed of the lower aqueduct channel
features.period: repairs in the days of Suleiman the Magnificent
features.quote: הוכנסו צנורות החרס לתעלה

features.subtype: rock-cut square chamber, opening facing north, nine kokhim in the south and west walls, two niches in the east wall; robbed
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: פתחו מכוון לצפון רבקירותיו הדרומי והמערבי חצובים תשעה כוכי קבורה

features.subtype: rock-cut tomb with at least four arcosolia; Christian burials
features.period: 4th-5th centuries CE
features.quote: הקבר חצוב בסלע והיו בו לפחות ארבעה מקמרים

title: פעולות שימור ושיחזור: עין גדי (conservation: En Gedi irrigation network)
author: (Department of Antiquities; Y. Porat)
location_note: En Gedi; sub-item of the conservation report; no map reference.
notes: One line: repairs to the En Gedi irrigation network under antiquities maintenance. Other sub-items (Beth Shean, Acre, Caesarea, Beth Yerah, Hammat, Atlit) are outside the region.

features.subtype: irrigation network of En Gedi, repaired
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: תיקונים ברשת ההשקאה של עין גדי

title: אתרים קדומים על שפת ים-המלח (ancient sites on the Dead Sea shore south of Ein Feshkha)
author: (survey of I. Blake, British School of Archaeology; reported)
location_note: Dead Sea shore south of Ein Feshkha (then in Jordan); no map reference. Not in a held area (south of Feshkha; no cave report).
notes: Sites from the Chalcolithic to the Byzantine period: walled site on a cliff top, two large shore sites (one with a 360 m wall, buildings and a tower, Iron Age, perhaps flooded), a small perfume workshop of the Early Bronze Age, remains of early Christian hermits' buildings. No feature of the eligible classes described.
